text: Good morning, you are through to the broadband support team. My name is Sarah. How can I help? Hi Sarah. My internet keeps dropping out every evening, usually around seven o'clock. I am sorry to hear that. Can you tell me which lights are showing on your router right now? The power light is green, but the internet light is flashing orange. Thanks. That usually means the line is out of sync. I will run a quick test from our side. Okay, no problem. The test found some noise on the line. I can book an engineer for Thursday morning. Does that work for you? Thursday morning is perfect. Thank you very much.

Hello, Riverside dental practice, Emma speaking. Hi, I would like to book a check up please. I have not been in for about a year. Of course. Could I take your date of birth and the first line of your address? Yes, it is the fourth of March, nineteen eighty six, and I live at twelve Mill Lane. Thank you. I have found your record. We have an appointment on Tuesday at half past two, or Friday at ten in the morning. Friday at ten would be better for me. Lovely. That is booked for you. We will send a reminder text the day before. Is there anything else I can help with? No, that is everything. Thanks, bye.

Right, let us get started. The main item today is the release plan for the new billing system. I have the numbers from last week. Error rates dropped by almost half after the patch went out. That matches what we saw in the logs as well. Good. So are we confident enough to move the launch forward by one week? I would rather keep the original date. We still need to finish the load tests on the payment service. I agree. One more week of data would also make the report much stronger. Fair enough. We keep the date. Can you both send me a short summary by Friday? Yes, I will have it ready by Thursday afternoon. Same here. I will include the load test results if they are finished.

Thanks for calling Swift Deliveries. Can I have your tracking number please? Sure, it is A B seven three nine two. Thank you. I can see the parcel is at your local depot. It will be delivered tomorrow before noon. Great. Can the driver leave it with my neighbour if I am out? Yes, I have added that note to the delivery. Brilliant, thanks.

You are speaking to the card services team. Before we start, can you confirm your full name? It is Daniel Morgan. My card was declined this morning when I tried to pay for petrol. Thank you, Mr Morgan. I can see a temporary block was placed on the card because of an unusual payment overseas. That was not me. I have not been abroad this year. Understood. I will cancel that card now and send a replacement. It should arrive within five working days. Will I get the money back for the overseas payment? Yes, the payment will be refunded once our fraud team has reviewed it, usually within ten days. Okay, that is a relief.

Morning everyone. Let us go round quickly. What did you work on yesterday and is anything blocking you? I finished the new sign up screens and shared them in the design channel. I am waiting on feedback from marketing. I will chase them today. I tested the password reset flow. I found two bugs, one on mobile and one with expired links. Is the mobile one about the button being hidden behind the keyboard? Yes, exactly. It only happens on smaller phones. Can you two pair on that this morning? I would like both bugs fixed before the demo on Wednesday. Sounds good to me. Sure. Great. Last thing, please update your tickets before lunch so the board is accurate for the planning meeting. Will do. I will also add the steps to reproduce both bugs. And I will attach the updated screens to the sign up ticket.
